items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrow keys fire in that direction only, never move the player. E places a bomb at the player's feet. Space/Q inert in an earlier run — don't retry. All heart outlines empty grey + bloodied sprite = death. Do NOT mistake the hopper's round white X-eyed face for the player's corpse.

TECH X (observed): obtained by stepping onto the green/white pill at the two-poop room's top-hatch landing. Goggles persist across rooms. Firing spawns a laser ring that lingers ~1s and grinds overlapping targets. RING OFFSET IS INCONSISTENT: vertical down-shots landed ~0.28 room-heights ahead when fired from the hatch area; a left shot from x~0.76 spawned only ~0.11 ahead; sometimes overshoots/side-offsets by ~0.05. Reposition the player instead of spraying. Works on poop piles (drop real '$'-faced coins after a short delay). Draws RED CRACK-LIKE OUTLINES on rocks/chests/props — ring trails, NOT damage. No effect on: '$' coins, golden keyhole door, shelled/armored hoppers, corner red-lidded chests, spike-ringed red chest, dark chest-room blobs, white spike rings, decorative wall cracks, or the torch room's gray BOMB-HEADED ENEMY (held ring on it ~1.1s, no kill — it appears immune; may explode on contact, threat unresolved). Props REGENERATE on re-entry (rocks, poop piles, chests, hoppers) — grinding rooms is pointless.

COINS/PICKUPS (observed): real coins are small golden '$' rounds; collect only by near-exact walking overlap (00->01). Laser ignores them. Blue orbs = SOUL HEARTS (+2 blue over 1 red) — grab them. Heart at full hearts converts to +1 bomb. Small yellow drip/flicker items are decorative and change no counter.

CHESTS (observed): gray metal chests open by contact once reachable (or firing). Torch room's central gray chest sits in a triangular rock ring: bombing the ring opened a path, then walking into the chest OPENED it, dropping a heart pickup (heal) and possibly a bomb orb. Same chest re-closes/regenerates on room re-entry. Dark chest room: two corner red-lidded chests resist laser (key or mimic guess); touching one cost several hearts at once; central red chest ringed by white spikes stayed closed.

BOMBS (observed): E places at feet; blast cracks/clears rock rings and rock pockets. Damages the player — a ~1.7s retreat still cost a heart, so retreat ~2+ s or leave the room. Bombing white spike rings and decorative wall cracks did nothing.

HAZARDS (observed): black spiders/dark blobs in the dark chest room are melee chasers; ring attacks did not kill them in ~4s. That room repeatedly costs hearts and yields nothing without keys — AVOID. Rock-field room white round-faced hoppers are extremely lethal: they phase, ring themselves with spiky gray rocks, leave green splatter clouds and green orbs that damage on contact, and fill the room with drifting BLACK DOT PROJECTILES that damage on touch. A short rock-field visit cost 3 hearts -> 1. Corner torches damage on contact. Hazard hits cost 1-3 hearts. Stay 2+ tiles clear of hoppers, green blobs and dot swarms; leave the rock-field at low health or when a hopper approaches.

TRANSITIONS (observed): gold trapdoors need centered sustained S; crown hatches need precise x-center and sustained W pushed from ~0.1-0.2 room-height below (standing on the hatch frame blocks the warp — step back down and re-center). Trapezoid doorways/alcoves need sustained walking plus fairly precise centering; standing on the frame can also block. Beware: in the torch room any S press near the bottom trapdoor warps down. Confirmed routes: tutorial TOP trapezoid -> rock-field; tutorial BOTTOM trapezoid -> torch room; tutorial RIGHT-wall doorway (spiked marking visible, band ~y0.47, near-exact vertical centering) -> dark chest room; torch room TOP alcove (x~0.50) -> tutorial; torch room BOTTOM gold trapdoor -> two-poop room; two-poop room TOP crown hatch -> torch room. Dark chest room's LEFT-wall brown doorway (~x0.24,y~0.47) exits to tutorial (pressing D in the tutorial re-enters it — beware). Torch room right-wall marking is decorative. UNRESOLVED/NEW: rock-field BOTTOM trapezoid exit to tutorial repeatedly failed despite centered sustained S and long holds; a dark spider-like object appeared sitting in that doorway — hypothesis (guess): something occupies/blocks the exit, or it is decorative/blocked.

MAP (observed): Tutorial room (WASD hint wall, top+bottom trapezoids, right doorway y~0.47). Below -> torch room (gray chest in rock ring, 4 corner torches, poop pile, roaming bomb-headed enemy, top alcove to tutorial, bottom trapdoor). Below that -> two-poop room (two piles flanking a gray rock; BOTH are destructible with Tech X here; the right one drops a coin after a delay, the left gave none — earlier belief that one is an indestructible blob is now doubtful; Tech X pill at hatch landing; only exit top hatch). Above tutorial -> rock-field room (many rocks, golden keyhole door on left wall ~x0.19,y~0.49, hoppers, green clouds and dot swarms, bottom trapezoid apparently blocked). Right of tutorial -> dark chest room (corner red-lidded chests, spiked central red chest, blobs/spiders, left-wall exit).

UNRESOLVED: what opens the golden keyhole wall door and the red-lidded/spiked chests (no keys ever seen; HUD always 00); whether the rock-field bottom exit works at all; what the dark object in that doorway is; what the bomb-headed torch-room enemy does or drops; source of keys and health drops; whether chest contents/positions are randomized per run.

FAILED STRATEGIES: contact/lasering locked or mimic chests with no keys; expecting laser crack outlines to mean damage; bombing spike rings and decorative cracks; lingering in the dark chest room; close-range firing (ring overshoots) and long-range firing (ring falls short); hugging torches; exploring the rock-field at 1 heart; assuming an open lane is clear; holding the laser on the bomb-headed enemy; standing on hatch/trapdoor frames while trying to warp.

ACTIVE GOALS: find keys (or another way) to open the golden wall door and red-lidded/spiked chests; survive the rock-field's hoppers/dot swarms; heal back up via chest drops and soul
